scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-badgeup "vitest run tests"
scripts.local: npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-badgeup "node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && VITE_USE_EMULATORS=1 vite --port 5178 --strictPort"
